purpose: Document primary local registry/custody evidence and bounded anonymous full-geometry discovery.
assessment: No primary city-local custodian or safe anonymous full-parcel geometry endpoint was established. The official directory only confirms a public service post. No geometry query was made because no target-specific public parcel feature service was identified.
registryAssessment: The official MAT public service-post directory includes Lobito, but the material found does not establish a local cadastral/title-register custodian. A secondary republication of the municipal organic statute describes land/cadastral responsibilities, but it is not primary evidence and is not used to assert local custody. No evidence from Luanda or Benguela is transferred to Lobito.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Ministry of Territorial Administration public-attendance directory; Lobito appears as a service-post locality, without evidence that the post maintains cadastral/title records.
Secondary republication of an organic statute; considered as a lead only, not relied on to assert primary local custody.
